name: TeamStarWolf - FBI Surveillance System Breach 2026 Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the FBI surveillance system breach case study, from the third-party path the FBI described on 3 April 2026 and the early-March notice's commercial ISP vendor infrastructure to the reported exposure of monitored targets' phone numbers. The notices to Congress are unpublished and no source names ATT&CK ids, so every binding is the study's own reading of Reported sources. Score 60: official words, as outlets quote them, state the behavior and the technique fits directly. Score 30: the fit is partly the study's inference. Scores measure the strength of the tie to this record, not severity. No malware, exfiltration channel or sub-technique is in the record, so none is bound. Comments carry the study's source numbers.
